candidates.summary: RM made return assurance / guaranteed return claim (completely safe): 'completely safe'.

rm_segments.text_english: Absolutely sir, you can rest assured. There is no chance of you incurring a loss in this. The money will remain completely safe. Good, it was nice to hear that.

regulation_citations.clause_text:
g. MFDs shall (i) not provide any indicative portfolio or indicative yield or indicative return
for any particular scheme or transaction and (ii) abstain from indicating or assuring 
returns for any particular scheme or transaction.
regulation_citations.heading: Client related obligations

regulation_citations.clause_text:
h. MFDs engaged in providing other financial services in addition to distribution of mutual
fund products, where other financial products with assured return are being offered to 
clients, MFDs and their employees shall ensure that they do not mis-sell mutual fund 
products on the basis of indicative or assured return or regular income to the customers 
seeking to make investments. It shall be explained to the clients that  MF investments 
are not  guaranteed or assured return products and that the principal amount may be 
exposed to risk of loss.
regulation_citations.heading: Client related obligations
